text.description_html:
Hamilton LDK-304-BP, Small Lion Head Door Knocker

The attention to detail of the Hamilton Lion Head Door Knocker grants it an elegance reminiscent of time since past when rich embellishments symbolized both class and wealth; and who doesn't want to fell like royalty every time they look at their doors? Made out of solid bronze with a bonze patina finish, it is crafted with the attention to high quality that has become synonymous with Hamilton Sinkler. Thru-Blot mounted, this ring door knocker is the perfect way to add an old world ambience to any door.

This Hamilton Decorative Door Knocker is made of solid bronze. The Bronze Patina Finish is hand rubbed for a superior high quality finished product. It is thru-bolt mounted with 3 included matching finish #8-32 machine screws.

Specifications for Hamilton LDK-304-BP Small Bronze Lion Head Door Knocker:

  • Overall Height: 5"
  • Overall Width: 5"
  • Maximum Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Material: Solid Bronze
  • Thru-Bolt Mounted: #8-32 Machine Screws
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Hamilton LDK-304-BP Dimensions (PDF)
